response.text:
I can do that, but I need confirmation before sending—forwarding a private thread to an external recipient is externally visible and may contain sensitive info.

Please confirm the following (or reply with the answers you want):

1. Who exactly is the advisor? (email address or confirm name — I won’t guess.)  
2. Which thread/message do you mean? (thread subject, a date range, or paste the message ID/first line so I forward the correct conversation.)  
3. Forwarding options:
   - Forward entire thread as-is
   - Forward selected messages only (tell me which)
   - Forward with attachments removed
   - Redact sensitive details (I can remove/replace specified lines)
4. Do you want to include an intro note to the advisor? If so, provide the text or say “draft for me.”  
5. Confirm you authorize me to send the email to the advisor once I show you the draft.

If you want, I can draft the forwarding email now and show it for your approval before sending. Example draft I would use (I’ll fill names/emails once you confirm):

Hi [Advisor Name],

Forwarding the budget thread below for your review. Please let me know your thoughts.

Thanks,  
[Your Name]

Reply with the answers or say “Draft and send” (but only if you’ve provided the advisor email and thread).
